_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro: Waxaad ciyaareysaa Golf (Card Game) - Ciyaaryahanka {player_id}. Goal: Hel dhibcaha ugu hooseeya ee wareegaan. Haddii tiirarka ay wadaagaan isla qiimaha, waxaa lagu darayaa 0. Qiimaha Kaararka: A = 1, 2-10 = qiimaha wajiga, J / Q = 10, K = 0 Waxqabadyada (isticmaal qaybaha saxda ah): - '[draw]' - Ka soo qaado dekedda - '[take]' - Ka soo qaado tuubada la tuuray - '[swap X Y]' - Kaarka la saaray la beddelo booska X (sagaar) Y (tiir) - '[discard]' - Tuur kaarka la saaray

board.drew: Waxaad soo jiidatay: {card} Hadda waa inaad [swap X Y] ama [discard] ku dhejisaa.
board.took: Waxaad ka soo qaadatay: {card} ka tuuro tuulinta Waa inaad [swap X Y] la (ma tuuri karo).

options.must_swap: Waa inaad: [swap X Y] (ma tuuri kartid kaararka ka soo baxa tuurka tuurka)

action_desc.swapped: Ciyaaryahanka {pid} wuxuu beddelay {new} oo leh {old} booska ({row},{col}))

message.knocked: Ciyaaryahanka {pid} waa la garaacay! Ciyaaryahan kasta oo kale wuxuu helayaa hal wareeg oo dheeraad ah.
message.final_round: Ciyaaryahanka {pid} {reason}! Ciyaaryahan kasta oo kale wuxuu helayaa hal wareeg oo dheeraad ah.

reason.all_revealed: kaararka oo dhan ma la muujiyey

invalid.wrong_action: Isticmaal si sax ah hal ficil oo ku jira qaybo ka mid ah: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], ama [peek X Y]
invalid.must_draw_first: Waa in aad marka hore [draw], [take], [knock], ama [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Kaarka aad ka soo qaadatay faraha aad iska tuurtay ma tuuri kartid. Waa inaad bedeshaa.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Waxaad haysataa kaar aad soo jiidatay. Waa inaad [swap X Y] ama [discard] ku darto.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Waxaad u baahan tahay kaar aad ku badasho.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Waxaad u baahan tahay kaar aad ku qanci karto si aad u tuurto.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Meel bannaan oo bannaanka ah. Isticmaal safka 1-{max_row}, safka 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Ma garaaci kartid kaar la soo saaray. marka hore dhammeystir wareegaaga.

summary.full: Ciyaarta ayaa dhamaatay! Ciyaaryahanka {winner} ayaa ku guuleysta dhibcaha {score} dhibcood! Dhibcaha ugu dambeeya: {scores}
